evaluation.cohort_exclusion: users with empty official train truth are excluded and counted in data report

all_official_train_users.definition: all users with non-empty official train truth; cold items remain in denominator

warm_users_and_all_truth_items.definition: user factor exists and every official train truth product has an item factor

evaluation.fallback: global prior popularity for users without ALS user factors in all-user evaluation only
evaluation.ground_truth: official order_products_train, distinct product IDs per user

tuning.selection_metric: full internal Recall@10, then Precision@10, then runtime

validation.threshold_selection: configured prior-only threshold; no official train signal used
